daily_summary: 当日变更以 TritonToGraph 的 BlockBatching（块批处理）能力为核心主线，新增了一套完整的 TTIR 级块批处理框架（分析、布局规划、循环调度、重写、守卫证明、运行时派发），并配套了自动选轴/选因子、隔离编译 worker、守卫（guard）运行时证明、launcher ABI v2、autotune/预热适配等基础设施；同时针对 CustomOp flatten 声明做了先加后回退的反复，另有 FP32→FP8 原生饱和转换修复、SelectedBlockScan 规则位联合注册修复，以及一个大规模的 PtrAnalysis 共享指针 lowering 恢复（涉及 TritonToLinalg/TritonToUnstructure 的指针分析重构、边界检查视图、循环偏移重写、原子值布局等）。整体方向是强化 Ascend 后端在块批处理自动调优、指针 lowering 正确性与边界处理方面的能力，改动量大、跨模块广、回归风险偏高。
test_impact_summary: 当日引入大量需要看护的新测试点：BlockBatching 新增了 C++ 单测（Workspace/EffectProjection/AffineProfiles）、lit 测试（cv.mlir、rejections.mlir、vv-lanes.mlir）以及多个 pytest_ut（compiler/memory/runtime/selection/worker/e2e），并新增 launcher v2 ABI 冲突校验用例；PtrAnalysis 恢复改动补充了大量 Conversion/General 下的 MLIR 回归（边界检查、偏移重写、指针视图放置、原子布局、bool 指针等），并调整了既有测试的 CHECK 顺序/常量类型；FP8 与 SelectedBlockScan 修复更新了既有的 lit/pytest 断言。这些变更不仅需要更新已有测试，还引入新的端到端设备正确性测试（test_block_batching_e2e.py 需真实 NPU），对 CI 覆盖提出更高要求；现有测试策略已在新模块上基本补齐，但 PtrAnalysis 重构涉及的共享指针 lowering 路径与既有测试可能存在覆盖空缺，建议补充针对性回归并确保 native/RTTI/UBsan 等构建变体均能跑通。

* [TritonToGraph](feat) coalesce private atomic group reductions

Recognize modulo-grouped row reductions and move their partial updates to a single program per group. Carry the original grid extent through the launch ABI and preserve the per-row partial storage precision. Retry with a smaller column tile within the UB budget only when the two row reductions are independent.

Reuse the normalized grid contract across launch spec construction and validate static cap fields when creating a native plan. Use the graph epoch contract at revalidation, and check reduction independence once when trying smaller column tiles.

commits.message:
[TritonToGraph](feat) restore block batching with TTIR selection

Restore VV/CV program batching with TTIR legality checks, automatic
axis and factor selection, isolated candidate compilation, and an
unbatched executable for guarded fallback. Integrate the selection state
and artifact publication with the compiler and JIT.

Use the same TTIR cost model to generate, score and rank candidates on
A2/A3 and A5, including Ascend 910B. Keep target-specific core counts,
backend resource checks and runtime guards. Invalidate prior cached
selections and persist audited deterministic refusals while keeping
resource failures, timeouts and unaudited outcomes retryable.

Resolve autotune warmup futures after internally managed parallel
compilation completes so callers receive compiled kernels and can read
attributes such as `.asm`. Preserve synchronous and caller-managed
asynchronous execution and propagate compilation failures.

Source PRs: #3252, #3335
Related: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-ascend/issues/3082

commits.message:
[PtrAnalysis](fix) restore shared pointer lowering

Restore shared pointer analysis in the Ascend lowering passes and keep
the legacy TLA entry points. Preserve bounded masks, checked origins,
position-embedding row copies and producer-local tensor views.

- Pad initialized load slices once when the consumer proves the slices
  disjoint and the padding values match. Keep per-row padding for
  overlapping, fallback and stride-two paths.
- Place checked block-pointer views at their descriptor when the remapped
  address inputs dominate it. Derive copy lengths from clamped GM origins,
  preserve static coordinates and physical pitch on singleton block
  dimensions, and use zero local offsets for aligned boundary tiles.
- Give singleton axes in tensor-of-pointers views the natural stride
  of their statically contiguous inner dimensions so DMA can identify
  a dense row. Keep the scalar offset and the explicit block pitch,
  and stop at gaps, unknown strides, empty dimensions or overflow.
- Use guarded scalar loads for eligible masked numeric singletons. Keep
  the kernel-argument base for bool bitcasts that lower to the same
  memref type and reuse carried scalar origins in nested offset loops.
- Derive atomic value-buffer layouts from the input tensor and retain the
  dynamic-offset exchange view required by the legacy A2/A3 path.
- Carry signed element offsets through loops with an invariant pointer
  base, retaining complete addresses for opaque or changing bases.
- On Ascend 950, copy active rows into a single-use fill. When the fill has
  other users, write only the masked suffix into an eligible single-use
  elementwise result.

Preserve the original regression coverage for pointer and loop lifetimes,
checked view offsets and slice bounds, atomic exchange layouts, and
row-select destinations.

Source PRs: #3291, #3314, #3336, #3377
